children: Italy hired banks for the syndicated launch of a new 12-year, October 2038-dated green government bond, or BTP, one of the banks said Monday.
The transaction is expected to be launched in the near future subject to market conditions, the same bank said.
The banks hired as joint lead managers are Barclays, BNP Paribas, Deutsche Bank, IMI-Intesa Sanpaolo, J.P. Morgan and Societe Generale.
